name: Leg Curl
common_faults: hips lifting off the pad during lying leg curl
not reaching full knee extension at the start

substitutions.note: compound hinge; more hip involvement; hamstring stretch under load
compound; more low-back demand; less knee flexion

contraindications: acute hamstring strain in the shortened position (lying curl)
resistance_profile: hardest mid-range at approximately 90° knee flexion; gastrocnemius assists less as knee flexes

provenance.notes: Isolated hamstring curl. Seated variant may have greater hamstring activation due to hip flexion increasing stretch. Nordic curl is significantly harder and highly effective.
